messages:
Maya R.: quick org update — runtime <> product liaison coverage gets shifted to reduce context switching across teams. Two new hires + one backfill incoming, details below. TL;DR: Priya (PM) starts 2026-04-07, Carlos (SRE) starts 2026-04-14, backfill for infra Eng Manager approved. Please read and react. :eyes:

Maya R.: headcount/motion (short):
```
- Product: +1 PM (Priya Singh) — primary liaison for Runtime product integrations
- Eng: +1 SRE (Carlos Mendes) — dedicated to Runtime infra stabilization
- Eng Manager backfill: hiring req approved, posting this week
```

Maya R.: onboarding owners: Lina will run first 2 weeks for PM ramp, Jordan will own technical kickoff, Maya + People Ops handles access and security checks.

Evan Carter: huge +1 on splitting liaison — should help latencies on cross-team tickets. Any impact to 0.9 rollout timeline?

Jordan Kim: not for critical path. We'll keep canary as-is. Liaison will help unblock post-canary iteration speed.

Lina Chavez: I’ll schedule the onboarding blocks and tag infra/product in invites. Need Priya/Carlos start dates so I can book 1:1s and doc walkthroughs.

RecruiterBot: offer sent to Priya Singh (PM) — email delivered 2026-03-20 16:42 UTC.

Priya Singh: excited to join! thanks everyone. I’ll accept once I review final comp details. :tada:

Carlos Mendes: accepted offer verbally, start 2026-04-14, will share calendar after relocation logistics.

Maya R.: thanks — People Ops will send formal welcome + benefits packet today and add both to the #new-hires channel. Lina, Jordan: expect invites from me by EOD.

Jordan Kim: can we add a 30m sync to align on observability handoff? I’ll add to calendars once starts confirmed.

Lina Chavez: added tentative 30m — subject: "Runtime onboarding: observability + dashboards".

Evan Carter: will prep a short notes doc on common incidents and SLO history to hand off. Posting in /docs/onboarding/runtime shortly.

Maya R.: hiring req link: https://redwood.hr/requisitions/5467 (permissions: company-internal). If anyone needs reviewer access ping me.

Jordan Kim: one ask — please cc eng leads on final offers so we can coordinate start-of-week planning.

Maya R.: noted. final note: this is intended to reduce interrupt overhead for eng teams and speed product iterations. Will share a short org chart + reporting lines tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Lina Chavez: congrats and welcome Priya + Carlos! :party:
file_notes: People Ops thread announcing liaison restructure, two hires and a manager backfill; includes short headcount snippet and onboarding owners. Slack-style short messages and bot notice.
